world mission sunday 1926-2026 world mission sunday is a powerful expression of our shared catholic identity. celebrated each year on the second-to-last sunday of october, it unites catholics around the world in supporting the church where it faces the greatest challenges. instituted by pope pius xi in 1926, this collection is unique: it directly supports 1,124 mission territories where the church is young, vulnerable, or facing persecution. on world mission sunday, catholics everywhere are invited to support communities that cannot yet sustain themselves. our prayers and donations help fund church construction, pastoral care, education, and healthcare. when your parish takes part, you join catholics worldwide in supporting missionaries as they build churches, train seminarians, form catechists, and serve vulnerable communities. together, we answer our baptismal call to share the gospel and bring hope to all peoples as one church.
